name: speed cap holds the cursor back
about: wpm 600 -> base 100 ms; two-letter words dwell 0.7 x base = 70 ms. The finger jumps to word 2 at once, the cursor follows one word per 70 ms (on 16 ms frames: 80, 160, 240) and stops at the first word the finger hasn't passed.
blocks: aa bb cc dd ee ff gg hh
